senses.gloss:
turīya
(‘the fourth’)
------------------------------------------
Treatises on Advaita Vedānta take recourse to a method called ‘avasthātraya-विवेक’ (‘analysis of the three states of चोन्स्चिओउस्नेस्स्’) to prove the existence of the आत्मन् (the individual सोउल्) as pure चोन्स्चिओउस्नेस्स् beyond the body-मिन्द् complex. Since it persists through all the three states of consciousness—jāgrat (waking state), स्वप्न (dream state) and सुषुप्ति (deep-sleep state)—it is called the ‘turīya’ or ‘the fourth’.
See also AVASTHĀTRAYA.
